label: KPI Stat Card
description: Canonical KPI stat card: label, dominant value, delta (arrow + signed change), and sublabel. Building block of the repo-tracker hero.

delta.label: Delta
delta.description: Change vs the comparison window, pre-formatted (e.g. "+18 (+7.9%)"). Omit for no-delta cards.

direction.label: Direction
direction.description: Delta direction — drives the arrow glyph and color (green up / red down).

sublabel.label: Sublabel
sublabel.description: Small muted caption under the delta (e.g. "vs last week").

backgroundColor.label: Card Color
backgroundColor.description: Card surface color. Pass "none" to render transparent when composed under a card-chrome primitive.

debugLayout.label: Debug layout
debugLayout.description: Dev-only: draw the layout contract (label / value / delta / sublabel fit their cells) instead of the card.

theme.slug.label: Producer slug
theme.slug.description: Producer template to seed tokens from when the namespace isn't already on ctx (e.g. "@m0saic/theming/v1").

theme.preset.label: Preset
theme.preset.description: Producer preset/variant to request (e.g. light | dark | high-contrast for @m0saic/theming/v1; producer-defined).

theme.namespace.label: Namespace
theme.namespace.description: Upstream alias to read tokens from. Default "theme".

theme.forceFetch.label: Force fetch
theme.forceFetch.description: Re-seed via the slug even if the namespace is already populated (collision escape hatch).

theme.label: Theme
theme.description: Opt into a theme source. Reads the card's own palette by default; set a producer slug + namespace to pull shared design tokens (self-seeds when nothing is upstream).

anim.countUp.label: Count up
anim.countUp.description: Count the value up on intro.

anim.slideIn.label: Slide in
anim.slideIn.description: Cascade-reveal the content in (label → delta → sublabel) with a subtle slide-up.

anim.introFrac.label: Intro length (× duration)
anim.introFrac.description: Fraction of the output duration the intro fills (the rest holds).

anim.introMs.label: Intro (ms, override)
anim.introMs.description: Absolute intro duration (ms). Overrides Intro length when set.

anim.reduceMotion.label: Reduce motion
anim.reduceMotion.description: Disable all motion — render the static final value.

anim.label: Animation
anim.description: Intro animation: count-up, cascade reveal, easing, duration, reduceMotion.
